children: The cost of insuring defaults at tech investor SoftBank
hit a four-year high on Wednesday, while overnight moves in US markets pushed gauges of tech company default risks to new highs.
SoftBank's five-year credit default swap spread (SFTB5YJPAC=MG) rose about 24 basis points on Wednesday to 501 bps. Cloud computer firm Oracle's
five-year credit default swap spread rose 17 bps to 356 bps, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence data.
